question.text: Ammonolysis of Alkyl halides followed by the treatment with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>NaOH</mi></math> solution can be used to prepare primary, secondary and tertiary amines. The purpose of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>NaOH</mi></math> in the reaction is.

options.text: to activate <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>NH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub></math> used in the reaction
to increase the reactivity of alkyl halide.

solution.text: So the purpose of NaOH in the above reactions in to remove acidic impurities.
